versions.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud DB Cost Diagnosis (0.0.1):

- Provides read-only cost diagnosis and auditing for Alibaba Cloud database products (RDS, Redis, MongoDB, PolarDB, DTS, DBS, CDT)
- Explains high or spiking DB bills with detailed billing-item breakdowns and month-over-month anomaly attribution
- Runs proactive audits for renewal/expiry risk, idle instances, and paid feature usage (read-only; never modifies resources)
- Follows strict read-only rules: only approved billing and monitoring APIs are used, with never any mutation or credential exposure
- All diagnostics are performed through bundled scripts; ad-hoc CLI/API calls are disallowed for reliability and observability
- Supports clear traceability and auto-filling of parameters (billing cycle, product, UID), notifying users when defaults apply
